title: Artifact Lifecycle Lab: Replication Package for Measuring Reference Integrity in Coding-Agent Instruction Files
description:
Replication package for the Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE) manuscript Measuring Reference Integrity in Coding-Agent Instruction Files: An Audited Longitudinal Study.

This archive contains frozen observational evidence (longitudinal panel exports RQ1-RQ4), extraction and verification code, audit materials, independent human validation labels, claim-to-evidence mappings, reproducibility documentation, exploratory runtime-probe ledgers (package label RQ5), protocols, and supporting analysis artifacts.

Version 1.2.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22009399) is the recommended package for EMSE manuscript readers. It updates public organization, documentation, and metadata; the underlying frozen scientific evidence is preserved and was not recomputed for this release.

Prior archival versions remain available for provenance (v1.1.0 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21716211; v1.0.0 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21711432). Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21711431.

Primary entry point: REPLICATION.md. Authoritative claim inventory: docs/SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_FREEZE.md. Validation protocol: docs/VALIDATION_EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md.

Reproducibility boundary: exploratory runtime-probe agent reruns require Claude Code CLI credentials and are not bit-identically regenerable; use committed ledgers for manuscript numbers.

Authors: César Andrés (corresponding); David Martín-Moncunill.
